Five months ago, in July, I bought a sofa and mattress from Leena Decor.
When the sofa and mattress were delivered, just one week later, the sofa started sagging, and its fabric started loosening.

After one week, when we complained, they sent a person who makes sofas.
He came and said that there's no problem, that it's normal for a sofa to be soft, and if we didn't want it that soft, they would need to add ply so that it wouldn’t sag.

The next day, we called again, and another person came. He said the same thing: wait for a month, and if it sags again, they would fix it. I also told him that bed bugs had started appearing.

After a month, the sofa sagged even more, and the fabric became completely loose with wrinkles all over it.

When I called to complain, they said they would come in a week to check the issue because the festival season was going on.

When they took the sofa, we went to their shop, and the owner was rude and started arguing. Then, they made the condition of the sofa worse and added ply underneath.

Since the sofa arrived, bed bugs have come with it. I raised this issue too, but they didn’t respond.

If you use poor-quality material, everyone is bound to get bed bugs.

These people have scammed so many customers. Who knows how many people’s money they've taken like this.

They take customers' money and provide terrible quality products.

Within one week, bed bugs appeared, which means the sofa was made from second-hand, cheap materials.

They are so cheap that they’ve only built a big showroom but are looting multiple customers.

I will only say this: if anyone wants to get trapped, then buy from Leena Decor. And if anyone wants bed bugs in their house, go ahead and buy from them
